claims.content: The Customer selects a bid amount for the selected auction item.
The Customer activates the applicable bid submission control (for example, 'Place Bid', 'Place Single Bid', or 'Place SmartBid') for the selected auction item.
The system checks the bidder's sign-in status before allowing the bid to be placed.
When the Customer has the required minimum information to bid, the system returns the bidder to the product details page of the item they initially tried to bid on.

Before the bid is placed, the Customer agrees to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement by checking the required checkbox labeled 'I accept and agree with the JTVauctions.com Terms of Use Agreement (required to participate in JTVauctions.com auctions).'

The system displays a bid confirmation pop-up telling the Customer they have just bid '$XX, using a "[type] bid"', with controls including 'Yes, Place SmartBid' and 'Cancel' (or equivalent for single bids).
The Customer confirms the bid by clicking 'Yes, Place SmartBid' or the equivalent single-bid confirmation button.
The bid is placed on the selected auction item, and the Customer remains on the product details page.

claims.content: A bid has been placed on the selected auction item.
After the bid is placed successfully, the Customer remains on the product details page of the item they initially tried to bid on.

After the bid is placed, the system displays the item in the Customer's 'My Current Bidding Activity' list with columns for Item #, Description, My Current Bid, My SmartBid, Current High Bid, Total Bids, Last Bid Time, Ending Time, and an Action column containing a 'Bid' button.

After the bid is placed, the system records the bid details in the Customer's Bid History, including Closed Date/Time, Auction Sequence, Item Number, Last Bid amount, Max Bid (SmartBid) amount if applicable, and Winning Bid status.
After the bid is placed successfully, the system updates the 'High Bid' and '# of Bids' columns in the auction history table to reflect the new bid amount and increments the bid count.

claims.content: The Customer wants to place a bid on an auction item.
The Customer has selected an auction item on which to place a bid.
The Customer is registered on the Website and has provided valid credit card information.
The Customer has agreed to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement.
The Customer initiates placing a bid on the selected auction item by clicking the bid action button (for example, 'Bid Now!', 'Bid', or 'Place Single Bid'/'Place SmartBid').
The Customer selects a bid amount for the selected auction item.
The Customer activates the applicable bid submission control (for example, 'Place Bid', 'Place Single Bid', or 'Place SmartBid') for the selected auction item.
The system checks the bidder's sign-in status before allowing the bid to be placed.
When the Customer has the required minimum information to bid, the system returns the bidder to the product details page of the item they initially tried to bid on.

Before the bid is placed, the Customer agrees to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement by checking the required checkbox labeled 'I accept and agree with the JTVauctions.com Terms of Use Agreement (required to participate in JTVauctions.com auctions).'

The system displays a bid confirmation pop-up telling the Customer they have just bid '$XX, using a "[type] bid"', with controls including 'Yes, Place SmartBid' and 'Cancel' (or equivalent for single bids).
The Customer confirms the bid by clicking 'Yes, Place SmartBid' or the equivalent single-bid confirmation button.
The bid is placed on the selected auction item, and the Customer remains on the product details page.

Diverges from Step 1: Instead of selecting a standard single bid amount, the Customer may use SmartBid (proxy bidding or max bidding) by setting a maximum bid amount, and the system auto-bids on the Customer's behalf up to that limit.
Diverges from Step 3: If the Customer has not signed in before attempting to place a bid, the system takes the Customer directly to the sign-in page instead of proceeding with the bid.

Diverges from Step 1: If the Customer enters a bid amount that is not valid (e.g., below minimum increment or exceeds maximum allowed), the system displays an error message and prevents the bid from being placed.
Diverges from Step 2: If the auction's Auction Status is 'Closed', bidding is not possible.
Diverges from Step 5: If the Customer does not agree to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement, the Customer cannot submit a bid on the Website. Exit: the bid cannot be submitted.
A bid has been placed on the selected auction item.
After the bid is placed successfully, the Customer remains on the product details page of the item they initially tried to bid on.

After the bid is placed, the system displays the item in the Customer's 'My Current Bidding Activity' list with columns for Item #, Description, My Current Bid, My SmartBid, Current High Bid, Total Bids, Last Bid Time, Ending Time, and an Action column containing a 'Bid' button.

After the bid is placed, the system records the bid details in the Customer's Bid History, including Closed Date/Time, Auction Sequence, Item Number, Last Bid amount, Max Bid (SmartBid) amount if applicable, and Winning Bid status.
After the bid is placed successfully, the system updates the 'High Bid' and '# of Bids' columns in the auction history table to reflect the new bid amount and increments the bid count.
